name: New Capenna
description: New Capenna is a tiered art-deco city, the one known remaining city on its plane, ruled by five demon-led crime families and sustained by Halo.

description_citations.text: "New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Streets of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

summary.text: New Capenna is a tiered art-deco city, the one known remaining city on its plane, ruled by five demon-led crime families and sustained by Halo.

citations.text: "New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Streets of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: After a Phyrexian ship invaded Capenna, angels and demons allied to found the city as a fortress, and it was sealed to all below.

citations.text: "Capenna", section "First Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Capenna", section "The creation of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Capenna", section "The creation of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The archdemons then betrayed the angels, converting their bodies into Halo, used it to defeat the Phyrexians, and appointed five families to rule before vanishing.

citations.text: "Capenna", section "Betrayal of the demons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"New Capenna", section "Betrayal of the demons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In the modern day Ob Nixilis, as the Adversary, struck the families' leadership at the Crescendo, killing Xander and mortally wounding Jetmir.

citations.text: "New Capenna", section "The Adversary War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Capenna", section "The Adversary War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Giada's sacrifice let Elspeth wound him, and it also began the awakening of the city's other angels from stasis.

citations.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Streets of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"New Capenna", section "The Adversary War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Elesh Norn sent Atraxa and ten thousand soldiers to cut off Halo, and they compleated most of the Maestros.

citations.text: "New Capenna", section "New Phyrexia's Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Maestros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The gangs dropped Park Heights on Atraxa and killed her, and the revived angels carried Halo to other invaded planes.

citations.text: "Capenna", section "Second Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Angel", section "Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Ob Nixilis was left stranded in the city without a spark.

citations.series: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
citations.text: Ob Nixilis, Captive Kingpin (March of the Machine: The Aftermath, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

status.text: New Capenna survived the invasion, with its angels awake and Ob Nixilis stranded there, and later stories show angels burning the demonic contract out of him and a young woman from the Family leaving for Strixhaven.

citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

citations.work: An Excerpt from Strixhaven: Omens of Chaos, a Magic: The Gathering Novel
citations.text: "An Excerpt from Strixhaven: Omens of Chaos, a Magic: The Gathering Novel " by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Fiero Vespin attacks Parnesse before her rehearsal dinner, breaking her ribs; she refuses to tell Errant.
timeline.quote: Fiero attacked Parnesse before their rehearsal dinner, leaving Parnesse with broken ribs and smelling of blood.

citation.text: "Parnesse", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Parnesse and Errant join the resistance against the Phyrexians; Parnesse is injured and healed by Della.
timeline.quote: but was later healed by Della and survived the invasion.

citation.text: "Parnesse", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth arrives in New Capenna, wondering whether this is the home Ajani said it would be.
timeline.quote: "Home," Elspeth murmured, seeing if the word fit New Capenna when said aloud.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Perrie heads off to a street fight with the Obscura, carrying the boy's cap.
timeline.quote: Perrie looks down at the cap in his hand thoughtfully.

citation.text: "The Contract Breaker" by Tobias S. Buckell. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: The Adversary, revealed as Ob Nixilis, learns what the Font is and toasts to taking over the plane at the Crescendo.
timeline.quote: "Here's to taking over the plane."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Tivit is gripped by a prophecy of a kitten hiding the cream, corvidae, gold in the water and halos, as Kamiz and Queza visit.
timeline.quote: "The kitten hiding the cream . . . Corvidae, flitting and pecking . . . Gold in the water . . . Hiding the cream, the kitten!"

citation.text: "What You Expect to See" by Kaitlyn Zivanovich. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Seers across New Capenna report the same vision at the same time.
timeline.quote: All reporting the same thing.

citation.text: "What You Expect to See" by Kaitlyn Zivanovich. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Denry Klin tells Kamiz and Queza that Lacey is probably out with Lagrella the Magpie.
timeline.quote: "One of those straightlaced Brokers. Lagrita or something."

citation.text: "What You Expect to See" by Kaitlyn Zivanovich. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Lacey is found in a dumpster with her mind wiped.
timeline.quote: Found her sitting in a dumpster in a stupor. Mind wiped."

citation.text: "What You Expect to See" by Kaitlyn Zivanovich. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Tivit's shop is set aflame and its balcony collapses; Kamiz rescues Tivit but Queza appears crushed before emerging unharmed.
timeline.quote: Kamiz projected her magic forward, gripping Tivit's thick fur and Queza's long coat

citation.text: "What You Expect to See" by Kaitlyn Zivanovich. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Kamiz foils a Broker agent's contract on Tivit with a mirror and learns the Riveteers smashed a new halo stained glass.
timeline.quote: The binding magic reflected to the agent and fizzled.

citation.text: "What You Expect to See" by Kaitlyn Zivanovich. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Queza finds halos in the buildings where visions occurred and says it is a message from the angels; Kamiz scolds her and removes her from the case.
timeline.quote: "You're off this case."

citation.text: "What You Expect to See" by Kaitlyn Zivanovich. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Kamiz confronts Lagrella in an illusory Mergino Fountain, and Lagrella reveals the Prophecy and that the Cabaretti figured out how to make Halo.
timeline.quote: The Cabaretti figured out how to make Halo.

citation.text: "What You Expect to See" by Kaitlyn Zivanovich. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Queza and Kamiz trap Lagrella with a mirror, forcing her to nullify Lacey's contract, which restores Lacey's memory.
timeline.quote: Lagrella's signature cracked the paper in two.

citation.text: "What You Expect to See" by Kaitlyn Zivanovich. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Kamiz admits Queza was right and returns her talisman and sigils, saying maybe she does not know everything.
timeline.quote: "Ridiculous. But maybe . . . maybe I don't know everything."

citation.text: "What You Expect to See" by Kaitlyn Zivanovich. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth tails a Maestros informant across rooftops to a door in a shadowed alcove.
timeline.quote: The vampire knocked on the door and waited.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Raccoonfolk ambush Elspeth in an alley and she bowls them over.
timeline.quote: she spun and used him like a battering ram to bowl over the others.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Dressed in Xander's tailored outfit, Elspeth visits a Cabaretti cabaret looking for work and is rebuffed by the bartender Rocco.
timeline.quote: Rocco gave her a look that said, Who do you think you are? and promptly walked away.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Kitt Kanto takes Elspeth to Jinnie, who agrees to give her a few small jobs for the Crescendo.
timeline.quote: "Then I think I have a few small jobs for you.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien follows Tezzeret down through the girders beneath New Capenna, wary of him but trusting her gut.
timeline.quote: Vivien trusted her gut and followed him deeper into the underbelly of this strange, new plane.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: At the bottom of the city Vivien notices the ruins of the first Capenna, with claw marks gouged into the stone.
timeline.quote: These ruins must have been the first Capenna.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reveals the glowing Planar Bridge in his chest as a show of trust, and admits it corrupted after carrying the praetors.
timeline.quote: "A show of trust and good faith."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells Vivien he works for Elesh Norn, and Vivien draws her bow on him in hostility.
timeline.quote: The bowstring was at her cheek in a breath, her opposite arm outstretched.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret admits he is playing both sides: he needs what Norn promised but does not want life destroyed or himself transformed, and Vivien relaxes.
timeline.quote: He was playing both sides.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret leads Vivien to a wounded Phyrexian, Urabrask, praetor of the Quiet Furnace, in a cavern below the city.
timeline.quote: "Vivien, meet Urabrask," Tezzeret said.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Urabrask accuses Tezzeret of betraying him, and Tezzeret says he has brought a new ally.
timeline.quote: "You betrayed me," Urabrask hissed to Tezzeret.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Urabrask explains he serves no one and will not give Elesh Norn the Quiet Furnace, and says he will lead a challenge to her control.
timeline.quote: "Yes. I will lead a necessary challenge to Norn's control."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien agrees to fetch Halo for the recovering Urabrask in exchange for his plan to bring Norn down, and learns the Planar Bridge wounded him.
timeline.quote: "You have a deal."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Urabrask asks Vivien to find Elspeth, a planeswalker whom Norn fears.
timeline.quote: "Norn fears her. That is all I know."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien tells Urabrask she found Elspeth; Urabrask says she is the key and he will wait for her, her spark igniting his people and the Mirrans.
timeline.quote: "She is the key to our success."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien resolves to be at the Crescendo where Elspeth will likely be, and learns from Urabrask that the Adversary is a demon planeswalker.
timeline.quote: "Tezzeret mentioned he is a planeswalker, too."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: In the alley, Vivien appears and kills the Adversary's goons with spectral wolves; Elspeth vouches for her to Giada.
timeline.quote: "Vivien's an ally; she can be trusted."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Jinnie, Jetmir and Cabaretti emerge and demand Giada be brought to them; Elspeth, sensing Giada's wishes, refuses.
timeline.quote: "Bring Giada to me."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien conjures a spectral dragon to block Jinnie, and the three flee into the night.
timeline.quote: the loops of a scaled dragon filled the alleyway.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: On the eve of his daughter's wedding, Anhelo takes Errant to a rundown neighborhood to buy information from Toluz.
timeline.quote: "Art's everywhere, if you know where to look,"

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Toluz agrees to tell Anhelo about the woman in white only if he kills Fiero Vespin, who has attacked her daughter Parnesse, by tomorrow's wedding.
timeline.quote: "If you want information for your Family, you have to do a little work for ours. Bump him off, and we'll talk,"

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Toluz reveals Fiero plans to use twenty goons to ruin the wedding, and Anhelo accepts the job.
timeline.quote: "Real considerate of you," he said.

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Anhelo sends Fiero an invitation to a private museum tour and asks Evelyn for a favor, agreeing to owe her.
timeline.quote: "All right," he said. "Name your price."

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Running late to the wedding, Anhelo takes a cab driven by a man who locks the doors and takes him on a reckless drive.
timeline.quote: the locks clamped down on the doors.

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: The driver reveals he is Severo, whose father Anhelo killed on his birthday three years ago, and drives into oncoming traffic.
timeline.quote: "It's Severo. And three years ago, you killed my father on my birthday,"

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: A Riveteer transport crashes into the car; Anhelo stabs Severo and survives the wreck.
timeline.quote: A huge Riveteer transport crashed into them like an angry rhox.

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Riveteers who own the Halo in the trunk surround the battered Anhelo, who resolves to fight his way to the wedding.
timeline.quote: "You want to dance?" he slurred.

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Toluz appears with the shadow generator's darkness and wipes out the Riveteers, saving Anhelo.
timeline.quote: When it was all over, she was the only one left standing

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Toluz calls Anhelo family and has a healer and a new suit waiting for him in her limo.
timeline.quote: "You're family, Anhelo."

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth, Vivien and Giada shelter in an abandoned warehouse, where Giada confesses her fear that her magic is not enough and Elspeth vows to keep her safe.
timeline.quote: "And I will personally ensure you are safe to take the time you need to do so, however long that is."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Jinnie and Cabaretti enforcers storm the warehouse office, disarming Vivien and holding a knife to Elspeth's throat.
timeline.quote: "You didn't really think you could escape us, did you?"

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Giada defends Elspeth, persuading Jinnie to let Jetmir decide; Jinnie shackles the two and takes them with Giada to see Jetmir.
timeline.quote: "Shackle them. We're taking them back to Jetmir."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Kamiz leads the group through Obscura tunnels toward the Cloud Spire; Giada drops a tracking bracelet and Elspeth destroys it.
timeline.quote: Elspeth ground the bracelet under her boot.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: The source of the Cabaretti's Halo is revealed to be a single teenage girl, Giada.
timeline.quote: The source of the Cabaretti's Halo turned out to be a single teenage girl.

citation.text: Giada, Font of Hope (Streets of New Capenna Promos, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After the attack on the Vantoleone, the balance of power shatters and the city descends into chaos.
timeline.quote: After the attack on the Vantoleone, the fragile balance of power shattered completely, and the city descended into chaos.

citation.text: Structural Assault (Streets of New Capenna Promos, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis smiles, a thousand years after his last conquest.
timeline.quote: Ob Nixilis smiled.

citation.text: Hostile Takeover (Streets of New Capenna Promos, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kitt Kanto survives assassins by holding a high note for nearly a minute.
timeline.quote: As the assassins converged on Kitt Kanto, she struck a high note and held it, unbroken, for nearly a minute.

citation.text: Incandescent Aria (Streets of New Capenna Promos, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: For years the five families ruled New Capenna in uneasy peace.
timeline.quote: For years, the five families ruled New Capenna in uneasy peace, and the city prospered.

citation.text: Meeting of the Five (Streets of New Capenna Promos, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis closes in on Giada; Halo sweeps through her and something long dormant awakens inside her.
timeline.quote: As Ob Nixilis closed in, Halo swept through Giada like an electrical current, and inside her, something long dormant unfurled its wings.

citation.text: Revelation of Power (Streets of New Capenna, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis decides to seize New Capenna by usurping its hidden power networks, and the Maestros fall first.
timeline.quote: Xander's Maestros were the first to fall.

citation.text: Murder (Streets of New Capenna, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A news crier announces that Lord Xander has been found dead.
timeline.quote: "Breaking news! Lord Xander found dead! Suspect at large!"

citation.text: Sky Crier (Streets of New Capenna, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: As the Adversary's forces descend on the gala, Elspeth offers to get Giada out.
timeline.quote: As the Adversary's forces descended upon the gala, Elspeth whispered to Giada, "I can get you out of here, but we have to go now."

citation.text: Daring Escape (Streets of New Capenna, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elspeth is branded the most dangerous criminal in New Capenna.
timeline.quote: Overnight, Elspeth was branded the most dangerous criminal in New Capenna.

citation.text: Most Wanted (Streets of New Capenna, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elspeth seeks answers while Xander needs a spy, and their paths cross.
timeline.quote: Elspeth wanted answers. Xander needed a spy.

citation.text: An Offer You Can't Refuse (Streets of New Capenna, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mikey the Mouth strikes a deal with Gregorio and never speaks again.
timeline.quote: Mikey "the Mouth" kept his nickname after he struck his deal with Gregorio, even though he never spoke another word.

citation.text: Buy Your Silence (Streets of New Capenna, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Investigators note that Altonio's fish thrive after his disappearance.
timeline.quote: Investigators observed that Altonio's beloved fish were thriving after his disappearance.

citation.text: Exotic Pets (Streets of New Capenna, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mr. Orfeo is jumped by a dozen Maestros agents and survives.
timeline.quote: Once he was jumped by a dozen Maestros agents.

citation.text: Mr. Orfeo, the Boulder (Streets of New Capenna, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Capennan angels cooperate with demons against a Phyrexian incursion and create New Capenna, but the demons then imprison the angels in stone and leech their halo.
timeline.quote: after its completion the demons betrayed the angels, imprisoning them in stone and leeching halo from their bodies

citation.text: "Angel", section "Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Streets of New Capenna the angels wake from stasis.
timeline.quote: the Angels began waking up from their stasis

citation.text: "Angel", section "Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Capennan angels repel Atraxa's invasion and carry Halo to other invaded planes.
timeline.quote: the angels helped repel Atraxa’s invasion of Capenna

citation.text: "Angel", section "Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Brokers lead the defense of Capenna during the New Phyrexian Invasion; Falco is a crucial target of Atraxa's massacre.
timeline.quote: The Brokers led the defense of Capenna during the New Phyrexian Invasion

citation.text: "Brokers", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A single Phyrexian ship invades Capenna, eating hope and poisoning the plane, and nearly succeeds before the archangels' intervention.
timeline.quote: a single Phyrexian ship invaded Capenna

citation.text: "Capenna", section "First Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The archangels see they cannot win as the Phyrexians raise the mortal dead against their comrades.
timeline.quote: it was plain to the archangels that they could not win

citation.text: "Capenna", section "First Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The archangels strike a deal with the archdemons, founding New Capenna as a fortress city.
timeline.quote: the archangels turned to an old, familiar enemy: the archdemons

citation.text: "Capenna", section "The creation of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Refugees stream into the city and the last elevator arrives; New Capenna is sealed to all below.
timeline.quote: the last elevator arrived, and New Capenna was sealed to all below

citation.text: "Capenna", section "The creation of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The archdemons plot to trap the angels and spread their essence across New Capenna to drive the enemy back.
timeline.quote: trap the angels, and let an age of demons begin

citation.text: "Capenna", section "Betrayal of the demons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The archdemons appoint five families, trap the archangels during a victory celebration and convert them into Halo, then vanish.
timeline.quote: The Demon Lords used the Halo to defeat the Phyrexians and then disappeared themselves.

citation.text: "Capenna", section "Betrayal of the demons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The five families dominate the city under an agreed code rather than law.
timeline.quote: Instead, there is an agreement, a code agreed to by the five families.

citation.text: "Capenna", section "Rule of crime". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis strikes the families' leadership on the night of the Crescendo, killing Xander and mortally wounding Jetmir; Giada's sacrifice awakens the angels.
timeline.quote: At least one boss, Xander , was killed, with Jetmir mortally wounded.

citation.text: "Capenna", section "The Adversary War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth arrives in New Capenna on Ajani's directions, feeling out of place.
timeline.quote: Arriving in New Capenna, she felt out of place as the plane was nothing like she imagined it.

citation.text: "Capenna", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The demons of Capenna cooperate with angels to stave off a Phyrexian incursion, then betray and imprison the angels in stone.
timeline.quote: the demons soon betrayed the battle-weary angels and imprisoned them in stone, leeching off halo from them

citation.text: "Demon", section "Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and her mother are captured by Phyrexians and held in prison.
